release_notes: If this update shows a network error (Cloudflare 524), it is usually still running on the server: wait a minute, reload the page, and do not press Update again. Access by groups and single entities: the permissions window gains Full + Selected and Read only + Selected for campaigns, offers, landings and domains - the admin checks whole groups and/or individual items, and the user sees those plus whatever they created, nothing else, in lists, by direct link and over the API. Groups are live: what is added to a granted group appears, what is taken out disappears; such a user cannot create, rename or delete groups, cannot regroup what they did not create, and can only add offers, landings and a domain from their own scope to a campaign. Statistics and the traffic/postback logs follow the campaign scope. A deleted account is signed out on its next request and a demoted admin loses admin rights at once. The Users page explains the whole system in a fold-away guide in seven languages, the role-template picker says what each preset grants, and the Video Editor preset is now Creative Designer. Offers and Landings trade the row of group pills for the group select. Panel updates run one at a time, survive a proxy timeout and are confirmed by the installed commit.
